PR: feat: deny protection.Usages across namepsace w/o by [closed]
### Description of your changes

Reject usages in namespace `foo` with no `by` resource if a namespace is specified for the `of` resource.

N.B.: even explicitly setting the same namespace `foo` won't be allowed. This is because, unfortunately, there is no way to access the object `namespace`, so we can't allow the special case where the specified namespace is the same as the one in which the `Usage` is being created. See docs

[here](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/extend-kubernetes/custom-resources/custom-resource-definitions/#specifying-a-structural-schema) (`if metadata is specified, then only restrictions on metadata.name and metadata.generateName are allowed.` #TIL 😡 We would need a webhook to do that.

I think the above could be acceptable, but I'm open to discussion.

Fixes #6367
